limitations: One fixed-order pair does not establish a reliability distribution.
Same build products reused, not two cold builds.
Products.json hashes were collected during serial, after parallel had finished; they are an artifact locator, not a before/after immutability audit.
Requested base simulator boot is a separate phase; clone startup is included in the parallel test command.
No assertion, test-plan selection, fixture-store identity or recovery boundary changed.
Local Xcode 27/iOS 26.5 evidence does not establish hosted Xcode 16.4/iOS 18.5 speedup.
